name: late-night-convenience-store-neon-girl
image_vibe: Harsh 35mm convenience-store light, pink-blue neon, cinematic late-night film grain
image_purpose: Create a candid late-night convenience-store portrait with authentic neon reflections.

prompt.project_info: A 35mm film street-editorial portrait outside a 24-hour convenience store at night.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long dark-brown hair in a messy high ponytail and natural dewy makeup. She wears an oversized white button-up shirt, fully opaque and securely fastened, with a modest black pleated skirt and simple white slides. She leans casually against the glass door while holding an iced drink.
prompt.composition_elements: Intimate medium shot, one leg bent and one straight, realistic glass reflections, blurred store shelves and snacks behind her, and a relaxed candid pose without sexualized gestures.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold fluorescent light from inside mixed with pink and blue neon outside, high contrast, slight color cast, hard reflections on glass, and cinematic late-night atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm film photography, authentic grain, high contrast, slight color shift, natural hair strands, realistic fabric wrinkles, detailed but natural skin, no plastic rendering or digital oversharpening.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an intimate medium 35mm film portrait of an original adult woman leaning casually against the glass door of a 24-hour convenience store at night. Give her long dark-brown hair in a messy high ponytail with loose strands and natural dewy makeup. Dress her in an oversized white button-up shirt fully opaque and securely fastened, a modest black pleated skirt, and simple white slides; she holds a bottle of iced drink. Include realistic glass reflections, blurred shelves and snacks, cold fluorescent interior light mixed with pink and blue neon, high contrast, slight color cast, authentic film grain, and cinematic late-night street-editorial mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, unbuttoned shirt, exposed cleavage, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized posing, transparent fabric, plastic skin, digital oversharpening, distorted anatomy, watermark, text
